title: Ishrat Jahan Encounter
description:
The Ishrat Jahan encounter case refers to the controversial case of 19-year-old Ishrat Jahan and three others by the Gujarat police in 2004. The police claimed that the four individuals were members of a Lashkar-e-Taiba. However, subsequent investigations, including by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), suggested that the encounter was staged. The case became a significant political issue, involving accusations of misuse of power and human rights violations.
